outcomes.text: Explain how light energy is absorbed by chlorophyll and used to make glucose during photosynthesis.
outcomes.assessment: Exit ticket: one paragraph explaining the role of chlorophyll.

outcomes.text: Describe the reactants and products of photosynthesis using the word equation.
outcomes.assessment: Label a diagram and complete the word equation.

outcomes.text: Explain why photosynthesis is essential for life on Earth.
outcomes.assessment: Short answer linking photosynthesis to food chains and oxygen.

outcomes.text: Describe balanced and unbalanced forces and their effect on motion.
outcomes.assessment: Annotated force diagram with a written explanation.

outcomes.text: Calculate speed using distance and time, including correct units.
outcomes.assessment: Three speed calculations with units shown.

outcomes.text: Identify and use ethos, pathos and logos in a persuasive text.
outcomes.assessment: Annotate a model text and label the three appeals.

outcomes.text: Write a persuasive opening that states a clear position.
outcomes.assessment: Draft an opening paragraph with a hook and a thesis.

outcomes.text: Add and subtract fractions with different denominators.
outcomes.assessment: Five worked calculations showing common denominators.

outcomes.text: Solve word problems involving fractions and explain the method.
outcomes.assessment: Two word problems with reasoning shown.
